description: Implement Admin Order Status Management allowing admin to update order status from dropdown with confirmation, timestamp tracking, and real-time UI updates. Critical for order fulfillment workflow.
steps: Modify updateOrderStatus() in database.js to add updatedAt timestamp field when status changes: orders[index].status = newStatus; orders[index].updatedAt = new Date().toISOString()

In admin orders table (ordersTable in index.html), replace static status badge with dropdown select element: <select class='status-dropdown' data-order-id='${o.id}'><option value='Pending' ${o.status==='Pending'?'selected':''}>Pending</option><option value='Processing' ${o.status==='Processing'?'selected':''}>Processing</option><option value='Delivered' ${o.status==='Delivered'?'selected':''}>Delivered</option><option value='Cancelled' ${o.status==='Cancelled'?'selected':''}>Cancelled</option></select>. Style dropdown with status colors.
Create status change confirmation modal in index.html: modal with heading 'Update Order Status', message showing old status -> new status, order ID, confirm/cancel buttons
In app.js loadAdminData(), add event listeners to all status dropdowns. On change, capture old status, new status, order ID, show confirmation modal with details

Add confirmStatusChange handler: on confirm click, call updateOrderStatus(orderId, newStatus), check result, show success/error toast, close modal, reload loadAdminData() to refresh both recent orders and full orders tables
On cancel in confirmation modal, revert dropdown to original status value and close modal without saving
Update both recentOrders and ordersTable displays to show timestamp when status was last updated (show relative time if status !== 'Pending', e.g. 'Updated 2h ago')
acceptance_criteria: Admin orders table shows status dropdown for each order with current status selected
Changing status opens confirmation modal showing order ID and status change
Clicking 'Confirm' updates order status, shows success toast, refreshes both order tables
Clicking 'Cancel' reverts dropdown to original status without saving
Updated orders show timestamp of last status change
Status colors apply to dropdown options (Pending=orange, Processing=yellow, Delivered=green, Cancelled=gray)
Status changes persist in localStorage and survive page refresh
verification: Navigate to Orders tab in admin panel
Select an order, change status from dropdown (e.g., Pending -> Processing)
Verify confirmation modal appears with correct details
Verify both orders tables refresh and show new status
Try canceling a status change - verify dropdown reverts
Check updatedAt timestamp appears for non-Pending orders
findings: Implementation complete. All status management features working as expected: updateOrderStatus modified to add updatedAt timestamp, orders table now displays status dropdowns with current status selected and color-coded styling, status change confirmation modal created with order details and old→new status display, showStatusChangeConfirmation function shows modal when dropdown changes, confirmStatusChange updates order and refreshes both order tables with success toast, cancelStatusChange reverts dropdown to original value, getTimeAgo helper function added for relative time display, updatedAt timestamp shown for non-Pending orders in orders table, CSS styles added for status-dropdown with color variants (pending=orange, processing=yellow, delivered=green, cancelled=gray). All changes persist in localStorage.
